title: Who was the flag for? Explorers and flags, for 5th graders
request: Make an explainer video for US 5th graders about flags in the age of exploration, built around one question: who was the flag actually for? Start with Columbus pushing a flag into a beach where people already lived, explain what the letters F and Y on it stood for, then show how Spain, Portugal, France and England each marked land they said was theirs — and end on the fact that every one of those places already had a name of its own. Everyday words and real comparisons instead of units, and don't soften what happened.
